justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/DetectionResultColumn.java` (95 lines): it has only 2 fields and 6 small package-private helpers plus `toString()`, all centered on one concern, storing/accessing `Codeword`s by image-row offset. `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/DetectionResultRowIndicatorColumn.java` extends it with the specialized row-indicator logic, and `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/pdf417/decoder/PDF417ScanningDecoder.java` uses it as a simple column container/accessor. The class is small and cohesive, so I found no evidence of insufficient modularization.
